posts.hook: anthropic is racing to a $200b future while quietly admitting its models got riskier
posts.caption: anthropic tells investors it'll hit $200b by 2028 while admitting its own misalignment risk went up, a chinese lab's open glm-5.3 edged past anthropic's own restricted model on a cybersecurity benchmark, and a mac zero-day is already being exploited for crypto mining. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
